title: USO incident at Pascagoula

tellings.quote: but a week or two later, there was a genuine USO incident right there.

plain: Richard Dolan, a UFO historian, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Pascagoula, Mississippi, in 1973. He says that a week or two after an earlier event there, a genuine USO incident happened at the same place, a USO being an unidentified object seen in or under water. He raises it as a sign the area had real, repeated activity.
